newsitem.title: CANADA: NOVA unit gets approval for B.C. gas plant.
newsitem.headline: NOVA unit gets approval for B.C. gas plant.

text.p: British Columbia said Friday it gave environmental approval to a C$22 million natural gas processing plant and pipeline project proposed by NOVA Corp's Novagas Clearinghouse Ltd in the province's northeast.

The government issued a project approval certificate allowing the company to begin construction and operation of a new gas plant about 160 km north of Fort St John. The plant would have capacity to process 1.13 million cubic meters a day of sour natural gas, a 21-km gathering pipeline, a three-km transmision pipeline and related facilities.
The company submitted its application in July.
